explanation.headline: Carvedilol is not on FDA's shortage list; Corvale General has 19.5 days on hand and the rule‑ranked alternate is Advagen Pharma Limited

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include carvedilol as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 283 tablets of carvedilol 25 mg, which at 14.5 tablets per day provides 19.5 days on hand.
The rule‑ranked first alternate manufacturer is Advagen Pharma Limited, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
A second alternate is Advagen Pharma Ltd., also not on the shortage list and with no plant identified on its label.
A third alternate is Aurobindo Pharma Limited, likewise not on the shortage list and with no plant identified on its label.
FDA inspection records for that plant show an OAI classification in 2009 and a series of VAI inspections through 2026, with the most recent VAI known date of 2026-10-14.

rejected.text: The current label for carvedilol 25 mg (NDC 71335247403) names Bryant Ranch Prepack as the registered plant (FEI 1000519407) with a VAI inspection on 2026-07-16.
rejected.reason: number 25 is not in the cited evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
